U.note: Huge clock, colour-coded phases, accurate end-time timing and good keyboard support, but notifications, confirm dialog, skip and cycle-clear make it a bit padded.

V.note: Lean full-screen timer with big clock, clear Start/Pause/Resume, sr-only announcements and a sensible auto-stop at each phase end; slightly plain.

W.note: Attractive dark card with progress ring, but tiny text, silent tab switching mid-run, settings inputs add bulk, and almost no screen-reader support.

X.note: Logic is sound and a11y thoughtful, but an inline font-size:inherit on the h1 shrinks the clock to tiny text, defeating the at-a-glance requirement.

Y.note: Clean light card with ring and tabs, works correctly, but small type, no live announcements, and a stray dead expression in the pips code.

Z.note: Most polished with big clock, progress bar, phase tabs and good a11y, but auto-start, chime toggle, notifications and persistence overbuild a simple timer.
